<module id="float_multi">
    <description>Implements a 32-bit floating point multiplier for IEEE-754 standard single precision arithmetic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal (active high).</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the multiplication in IEEE 754 format.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="INIT">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="INPUT">State where inputs are processed.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SPECIAL_CASES">State where special cases are handled.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NORMALIZE">State where mantissas are normalized.</parameter>
        <parameter id="MULTIPLY">State where mantissas are multiplied.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ROUND_ADJUST">State where rounding and adjustment are performed.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">Final state where the result is generated.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="counter" type="reg" width="3">Cycle counter for operation sequencing.</signal>
        <signal id="a_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of input number a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of input number b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_mantissa" type="reg" width="24">Mantissa of output number z.</signal>
        <signal id="a_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of input number a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of input number b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_exponent" type="reg" width="10">Exponent of output number z.</signal>
        <signal id="a_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of input number a.</signal>
        <signal id="b_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of input number b.</signal>
        <signal id="z_sign" type="reg">Sign bit of output number z.</signal>
        <signal id="product" type="reg" width="50">Intermediate product of the mantissas.</signal>
        <signal id="guard_bit" type="reg">Guard bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="round_bit" type="reg">Round bit for rounding.</signal>
        <signal id="sticky" type="reg">Sticky bit for rounding.</signal>
        
        // State machine variables
        <parameter id="INIT">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="INPUT">State where inputs are processed.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SPECIAL_CASES">State where special cases are handled.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NORMALIZE">State where mantissas are normalized.</parameter>
        <parameter id="MULTIPLY">State where mantissas are multiplied.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ROUND_ADJUST">State where rounding and adjustment are performed.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">Final state where the result is generated.</parameter>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Initialize counter
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                counter <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                case(counter)
                    INIT: begin
                        // Process inputs
                        a_mantissa <= {1'b1, a[22:0]};
                        b_mantissa <= {1'b1, b[22:0]};
                        a_exponent <= a[30:23];
                        b_exponent <= b[30:23];
                        a_sign <= a[31];
                        b_sign <= b[31];
                        counter <= INPUT;
                    end
                    
                    INPUT: begin
                        // Handle special cases
                        if ((a_exponent == 8'hFF && a_mantissa != 24'h0) || (b_exponent == 8'hFF && b_mantissa != 24'h0)) begin
                            z <= {a_sign ^ b_sign, 8'hFF, 23'h0}; // Set output to NaN
                            counter <= OUTPUT;
                        end else if ((a_exponent == 8'hFF) || (b_exponent == 8'hFF)) begin
                            z <= {a_sign ^ b_sign, 8'hFF, 23'h0}; // Set output to Infinity
                            counter <= OUTPUT;
                        end else begin
                            // Normalize mantissas if necessary
                            if (a_exponent == 8'h0) begin
                                a_mantissa <= {1'b0, a[22:0]};
                                a_exponent <= 8'h1;
                            end
                            
                            if (b_exponent == 8'h0) begin
                                b_mantissa <= {1'b0, b[22:0]};
                                b_exponent <= 8'h1;
                            end
                            
                            // Multiply mantissas
                            product <= a_mantissa * b_mantissa;
                            // Adjust exponent
                            z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 8'h7F;
                            // Determine sign of output
                            z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
                            // Move to next state
                            counter <= MULTIPLY;
                        end
                    end
                    
                    MULTIPLY: begin
                        // Perform rounding and adjust exponent
                        guard_bit <= product[24]; // Guard bit
                        round_bit <= product[23]; // Round bit
                        sticky <= |product[22:0]; // Sticky bit
                        
                        if (guard_bit & (round_bit | sticky | product[23])) begin
                            z_mantissa <= product[49:25] + 1;
                            if (z_mantissa[23]) begin
                                z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1;
                            end
                        end else begin
                            z_mantissa <= product[49:25];
                        end
                        
                        // Check for overflow/underflow
                        if (z_exponent >= 8'hFF) begin
                            z <= {z_sign, 8'hFF, 23'h0}; // Set output to Infinity
                        end else if (z_exponent <= 8'h0) begin
                            z <= {z_sign, 8'h0, 23'h0}; // Set output to Zero
                        end else begin
                            z <= {z_sign, z_exponent[7:0], z_mantissa[22:0]};
                        end
                        
                        // Move to next state
                        counter <= OUTPUT;
                    end
                    
                    OUTPUT: begin
                        // Finalize output
                        // No need to do anything here, just move back to initial state
                        counter <= INIT;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
